messages:
jess_support: Heads-up — customer (Acme Mobile) escalated. They saw a sharp client-side spike right after token refresh, lots of 429s, and a few customers reported duplicate charges. Attaching repro and logs below.

jess_support: Repro steps the app team gave: 1) app refreshes auth token on resume, 2) it immediately replays ~10 pending requests, 3) SDK default retries kick in. Happens on iOS and Android.

nina_prod: Thanks. Do we have the exact response headers from our side for one of those 429s? That'll tell us whether Retry-After or quota headers were included.

jess_support: Pasted one full request/response below (sanitized):

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <user-token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2028 17:10:12 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 123
x-redwood-rate-limit-limit: 12000
x-redwood-rate-limit-remaining: 3
x-redwood-rate-limit-reset: 1710324618
x-redwood-burst-window-seconds: 60
retry-after: 8

{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"burst window exceeded"}
```

jess_support: Note: remaining dropped to 3 because of a short fanout by the mobile client (10 concurrent retries).

sam_support: Were the duplicate charges definitely from our side or the payment processor? Need to know if idempotency key was missing or if retries caused multiple accepted ops.

jess_support: Customer said some operations were billed twice. They use a single non-idempotent endpoint for invoicing in the mobile flow. SDK doesn't auto-add idempotency keys for that endpoint currently.

tim_eng: Ok — two separate issues: 1) client fanout + instant retries causing transient quota exhaustion, 2) non-idempotent ops getting retried without an idempotency key.

tim_eng: Short-term mitigation: recommend customer set client-side concurrency cap (<=3) and honor Retry-After header before retrying. Also advise adding idempotency keys for payment endpoints.

nina_prod: Can we reproduce internally? Jess, can you drop a small script that simulates the token rotate + request replay pattern so we can observe headers and our quota accounting?

jess_support: Pasted minimal repro that the mobile team used (node):

```js
// repro-client.js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function sendBurst(token) {
  const promises = Array.from({length:10}).map(() => fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { 
      method: 'POST', 
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'x'.repeat(100) })
    })
  );
  return Promise.all(promises);
}

(async ()=>{
  const token = 'rotated-token';
  // token rotate then immediate replay
  await sendBurst(token);
})();
```

jess_support: When we run this against their account creds we hit 429s and see remaining fall to low single digits within one second.

tim_eng: Repro ok. For SDK defaults: what are we shipping? IIRC mobile SDK default retry = 4 attempts with exponential backoff starting at 300ms, cap 4s, no jitter in older versions. That combination + instant fanout can push multiple requests through before server-side rate window recalcs.

nina_prod: We should change guidance: 1) add jitter to backoff, 2) reduce default maxRetries to 3 for mobile, 3) recommend honoring Retry-After strictly for 429s. Also consider adding a client-side token-bucket limiter in SDK to smooth bursts.

tim_eng: Agree. Also server-side: add a short soft-deny window header (we already have x-redwood-burst-window-seconds) — make sure SDK surfaces that so clients can respect burst cooldown.

sam_support: Action items for now (customer-facing):
- advise app devs to add idempotency keys for billing calls
- advise to throttle replayed requests (cap concurrency + small queue)
- recommend SDK upgrade (we'll ship a patch)
- we can temporarily increase their quota if they need to recover while they patch

jess_support: Customer is asking for patch ETA. Can we scope the SDK changes?

tim_eng: I'll open an eng-infra ticket. Plan: patch mobile SDKs to 1) default maxRetries -> 3, 2) backoff -> expo with full jitter between 200ms and 2000ms, 3) expose a TokenBucket throttle option and built-in idempotency helper for common payment endpoints. ETA: 3 business days to ship patch to beta channels.

nina_prod: Also adding a server-side safeguard: when we detect a token-rotate fanout pattern (many requests from same auth refresh window), we can return Retry-After and a correlate-id header to help clients coalesce. Will need a short RFC but doable in next sprint.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: mobile-sdk patch branch created by @tim_eng. CI queued.

jess_support: I'll send these mitigation steps to the customer and offer a temporary quota bump. I'll also ask them to enable debug logs and share a timestamped trace if it happens again.

sam_support: Please cc eng-infra on the customer reply and include the repro script.

jess_support: Will do. Marking this thread resolved for support; follow-ups in eng-infra ticket. :thumbsup:
